entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I'm calling because I need to return something. I ordered a helmet a while back, and I just... I can't keep it.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I just really feel terrible about this. With things being so tight, I was hoping I could get the money back.
I understand. Let me just pull up that order. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, placed about 50 days ago. Can I ask what the issue is with the item?
Oh, there's no issue with it! The box is still unopened. It's just... the color wasn't quite what I expected, and I never even took it out. I just put it aside and honestly forgot until now.
I see. So it's in brand new condition, then. Let me just quickly check our return policy for you.
Please, I'd be so grateful. I wouldn't ask if it wasn't important.
Of course. Okay, looking here... yes, you are well within our 90-day return window. Since the item is unused and the box unopened, we can absolutely process that return for a full refund for you.
Oh, really? Oh, thank you so much! That's such a relief. I was so worried.

Not a problem at all. Your satisfaction and safety are our top priorities. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the shipping box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
That is wonderful news. Thank you, David. You've really helped me out today.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
